buildCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory '*' && if [ ! -f flutter/bin/flutter ]; then rm -rf flutter && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && ./flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics && ./flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
